question: Is any fire-pit larger than ten hastas permitted in the scriptural traditions?
premises: Ten hastas is stated as a boundary.
The existence of a fire-pit beyond that boundary is denied.
This denial applies even across all āgamas.
inference: No fire-pit larger than ten hastas exists in any of the āgamas.
plain_english: There is no fire-pit larger than ten hastas, even in all the āgamas.
